header.running_head: The Practices of Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA) with Food and Drink

blocks.text: Rasulullaah ﷺ is Entertained by the Sahabah (RA)

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Busr (RA) relates, "Nabi ﷺ once stopped over by my father, who served him a meal of Saweeq[^1] and Hais[^2]. After Rasulullaah ﷺ had eaten, my father brought something to drink. After drinking, Rasulullaah ﷺ passed the cup on to the person on his right. When eating dates, Rasulullaah ﷺ threw the stones like this." Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Busr (RA) then pointed with his finger towards his back (to indicate that Rasulullaah ﷺ threw the stones behind him). Narrating further, he says that when Rasulullaah ﷺ got on his mule, his father held the reins and said, "Do make du'aa for us, O Rasulullaah ﷺ!" Rasulullaah ﷺ then made the following du'aa:

blocks.arabic_text: اَللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيْمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
blocks.text: "O Allaah! Bless them in the sustenance You give them, forgive them and have mercy on them." [^3]

In another narration, Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Busr (RA) says, "When my father once asked my mother to prepare some food for Rasulullaah ﷺ, she prepared some Thareed. My father then proceeded to invite Rasulullaah ﷺ for the meal and (when he arrived) Rasulullaah ﷺ placed his hand on the top of the dish saying (to the Sahabah (RA)), 'Dish out taking the name of Allaah.' They then dished out from the sides. After everyone had eaten, Rasulullaah ﷺ made the following du'aa:

blocks.arabic_text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ وَبَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيْمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ
blocks.text: "O Allaah! Forgive them, have mercy on them and bless them in the sustenance You give them." [^4]
The Practices of Hadhrat Ali (RA) and Hadhrat Umar (RA) with Food and Drink

Hadhrat Ibn A'bad reports that Hadhrat Ali (RA) once asked, "O Ibn A'bad! Do you know what is the right of food?" "What is the right of food?" Ibn A'bad asked. Hadhrat Ali (RA) replied, "That you recite:

blocks.arabic_text: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ اَللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيْمَا رَزَقْتَنَا
blocks.text: 'I begin with the name of Allaah. O Allaah! bless us in the sustenance You give us'"
Thereafter, Hadhrat Ali (RA) asked, "And do you know how to express gratitude after you have finished?" "How do you express gratitude?" Ibn A'bad asked. Hadhrat Ali (RA) replied, "By saying:
A type of porridge prepared from barley.
A sweet dish prepared with dates, butter and flour.
Ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Nu'aym.
Haakim, as quoted in Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.8 Pg.47).
